explanation: The library defines `hankelIdeal k n` as `Ideal.span (Set.range (hankelMinor k n))`, so the theorem only says that a generator lies in the ideal it generates. Its proof is generic glue: `Ideal.subset_span` together with `Set.mem_range_self`. All the content comes from the library's own definitions, so no Mathlib declaration carries it. Mathlib has no Hankel-minor or rational-normal-curve ideal for this to duplicate. I read the two library definitions in `ToricIdeals/RationalNormalCurve.lean` (lines 148–153) and did not search Mathlib further, since the generic lemmas used here do not count as a match.
